initialExam.title: APPSC Group 2 Services 2026
initialExam.description: APPSC Group 2 exam for middle-level administrative posts in AP government departments.
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: GS & Mental Ability (150Q). Paper-II: AP Movement, Society & Culture (150Q). Paper-III: Indian & AP Economy (150Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Screening: 150Q, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. Mains: 3 papers, 450 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Tahsildar, Municipal Commissioner Gr-II, Sub-Registrar, and other Group 2 posts
initialExam.careerGrowth: Tahsildar → RDO → Joint Collector through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit psc.ap.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, State benefits
